signal: ASI's iMIS was named to G2's 2026 Best Software Awards and launched Emergence 2026, a new flagship conference for the iMIS community

email.body1:
Ed, saw iMIS land on G2's 2026 Best Software Awards and ASI launch Emergence 2026 for the community.

Momentum like that opens conversations across associations and nonprofits, usually more accounts in-market than the North America team can cover at once. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ed, quick follow-up for ASI.

Awards and a new conference spike interest, but most teams can't tell how many of those prospects they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up late in the year.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your client-sales team needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ed, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to peer association-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ed, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling client pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new flagship conference is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an association-software motion? I'll tailor it to ASI either way.
